parchment.name: Parchment
parchment.role: Light ground. Official paper, never gray.

flame.name: Flame
flame.role: Non-text accent: BURN moments, display numerals, highlights. Never carries text. ≤10%.

ember.name: Ember
ember.role: Fire at text size: primary buttons, links, labels, hovers.

families.use: Large headlines, 36px and up. Fine, engraved hairlines. Regular + Italic only. No bold exists.
Serif moments from 22–36px: pull quotes, the prophecy, document headings. Regular + Italic only.
Everything functional: body, nav, labels, buttons, sub-brand materials. Weights 400–700 with true italics.

stacks.serifDisplay: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
stacks.serifText: 'DM Serif Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

typography.source: Google Fonts, free for every volunteer, partner, and field team
typography.retired: Proxima Nova, fully retired. Fallbacks: Georgia for the serifs, system sans for DM Sans.

button-hover.name: Button hover
button-hover.rule: Ember deepened ~10%. State-only. Never a palette color.

focus-ring.name: Focus ring
focus-ring.rule: Visible on every interactive element. Never removed.

success-state.name: Success state
success-state.rule: Forms and dashboards only. Never in brand layouts.

photo-video-scrim.name: Photo/video scrim
photo-video-scrim.rule: Required under any text on imagery (§07).

muted-text.name: Muted text
muted-text.rule: Captions and metadata. Nothing lighter. It fails contrast.

cssVariables.serif-display: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
cssVariables.serif-text: 'DM Serif Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
